panels.title: Recent Decision Mode traces
panels.description: Most recent traces emitted by the axonflow-agent service. Decision Mode requests show up as spans named `axonflow.decision`. Click any row to open the trace detail view.

options.content:
## Decision Mode traces (bundled install)

Every call to `POST /api/v1/decide` emits an OpenTelemetry span via the AxonFlow agent's Decision Mode tracer. Spans land in the bundled OTel collector and are stored in the bundled Tempo instance. Each span carries `decision.verdict`, `decision.stage`, `decision.id`, `decision.latency_ms`, `org.id`, and `tenant.id` as attributes - open any row in the table to see the full attribute set.

**Why this matters for audit visibility:** the `GET /api/v1/ojk/dashboard` and `POST /api/v1/ojk/audit/export` endpoints index gateway/proxy traffic only. Decision Mode requests (the modern policy-decision path) need a trace backend, and that backend ships in this bundle as of v8.3.x.

**Quick test:** from the host, send a Decision Mode request. Within ~10 seconds it appears in the trace table above.

**Trace retention:** 24 hours (eval-scoped). For production-grade retention, point Tempo at S3/GCS.
